description:
Check the account's credit and usage: the balance left, the plan, whether a new file or live transcription would start now (and what would refuse it), and this period's limits.
Use: before a long or live transcription, after an insufficient_credit or quota_exceeded error, or to tell the user what they have left. Prices per minute are in create_transcription and start_broadcast; adding credit happens at topUpUrl, in a browser.
Arguments: none.
Behaviour: free and read-only; nothing is cached, each call reads the account as it is at that moment, including a live run still being billed. Calling it changes nothing and spends nothing. Gives rate_limited (with retryAfterS) past 600 calls a minute per API key.
Returns: billingEnabled; plan (id, name, kind) or null; balance in US dollars (negative while a plan lets a running transcription continue below zero); canStart and startBlock (no_credit or hourly_limit, null when it starts) for a file; canStartLive and startBlockLive (also concurrency) for a live one; running, concurrentLimit, createdLastHour and createLimit (null means unlimited); period (start, end); monthlyCredit when a plan grants one; usageCap (amount, period, used, resetsAt) when this API key has a spending cap; topUpUrl; for a signed-in person termsAccepted, and while false acceptUrl: a page where they accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy themselves, once, before their first transcription.
Errors: rate_limited (with retryAfterS); forbidden for a token without the read scope.
name: get_account
title: Check credit and usage
